title: Mikano International Limited
wikitext:
{{Short description|Nigerian company}} {{Use Nigerian English|date=June 2026}} {{Infobox company | name = Mikano International Limited | logo = Mikano_Logo_transparent.png | logo_caption = | type = [[Private company|Private]] | founded = 1993 | hq_location = Mikano Head Office
34,35 Acme Road, Ogba, [[Ikeja]], [[Lagos State]], Nigeria | areas_served = Nigeria | key_people = Mofid Karameh {{small|(Chairman)}} | industry = [[Heavy equipment (construction)|Heavy equipment]], [[Automotive industry|Automotive]] | products = [[Electrical generator|Power Generation]] | website = {{url|https://mikano-intl.com}} }} '''Mikano''' International Limited is a [[Nigeria|Nigerian]] company in the [[Electricity generation|power generation]], [[real estate]] and [[construction]] sectors.{{cite web|url=https://nairametrics.com/2018/10/25/generating-set-brands-in-nigeria/|title=Generator brands battle for market share amidst growing darkness in Nigeria|first=Fikayo|last=Owoeye|date=25 October 2018}} This company offers sales, maintenance, assembly and distribution of [[Electricity generation|power generation]] products, [[real estate]] development, and sales of construction equipment. Headquartered in [[Lagos|Lagos, Nigeria]], Mikano assembles power generating sets from manufacturers; MTU Onsite Energy ([[Germany]]), Perkins and Stamford alternator ([[United Kingdom]]), providing [[Diesel fuel|diesel]] and gas generating sets ranging from 9kva to 20,000kva for homes and industries. ==History== [[File:Mikano International Limited, Head Office.jpg|thumb|left|Mikano International Limited, Head Office]] Established in 1993 with a focus on importing, servicing, and maintenance of generators, Mikano began to assemble generating sets in [[Nigeria]].{{cite web|url=https://marcopolis.net/exclusive-interview-with-mikano-international-the-leading-manufacturer-of-generators-in-nigeria.htm|title=Exclusive Interview with Mikano International, the Leading Manufacturer of Generators in Nigeria|website=marcopolis.net}} Mikano has further diversified its activities from power generation into steel fabrication, electronics and lighting, and the construction industry.{{Cite news|last=Thomas |first=Ijeoma |url=https://guardian.ng/appointments/mikano-steel-factory-generates-over-2000-jobs/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|title=Mikano steel factory generates over 2000 jobs | The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World NewsAppointments — The Guardian Nigeria News – Nigeria and World News |date=2019-05-24 |access-date=2019-05-28|newspaper=[[The Guardian (Nigeria)|The Guardian]]}} In 2016, it expanded its operation into the real estate space with the Karameh City Project, an industrial complex in Nigeria with eight warehouses measuring 7,200 square meters, located at Warewa, [[Ogun State|Ogun state]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.blueprint.ng/mikano-ventures-into-real-estate/|location=Abuja, Nigeria|title=Mikano ventures into real estate|first=BluePrint|last=Newspapers|date=12 December 2018|newspaper=[[Blueprint (newspaper)|Blueprint]]}} == Business activities == Mikano has partnered with [[Schneider Electric]],{{cite web|url=https://theeagleonline.com.ng/schneider-electric-mikano-sign-mou-on-electrical-distribution/|title=Schneider Electric, Mikano sign MOU on electrical distribution|date=18 September 2013}} [[ABB]], [[Raychem]] (as stockist of MV & HV products), [[Philips]] Lightings (as the supplier of fittings and lighting products) and [[Siemens]] (for type-tested compact sub-stations).{{cite web|url=https://mikano-intl.com/divisions/products-and-solutions|title=Mikano International Limited|website=mikano-intl.com}} === Power generation === [[File:Mikano Power Generating Set.jpg|thumb|Mikano Power Generating Set]] As an assembler of power generating sets for homes and industries, Mikano produces: * [[Compressed natural gas|Compressed Natural Gas]] (CNG) power generating sets * Bi-fuel power generating sets operating on 70% gas and 30% diesel * [[Independent power producer|Independent Power Producer]] with Gas/Diesel power generation options, providing up to 60MW * MAN Diesel and Gas generators up to 20,000 KVA{{Cite news|url=https://leadership.ng/2018/12/03/mikano-mtu-partner-to-deliver-ipp-gas-energy/|title=Mikano, MTU Partner To Deliver IPP Gas Energy|first=Olushola|last=Bello|date=3 December 2018|newspaper=[[Leadership (newspaper)|Leadership]]}} === Steel fabrication === [[File:Mikano International Limited, Panel Section.jpg|thumb|Mikano Factory Panel Section]] In 2015, Mikano set up a [[steel]] fabrication factory where it manufactures and fabricates steel designs for street lamps, warehouse racks, supermarket shelves, and sound-proof canopies for generators.{{cite web|url=https://www.bellanaija.com/2015/09/unveiling-mikanobeyond-power-generation/|title=Unveiling Mikano…Beyond Power Generation|last=BellaNaija.com|date=9 September 2015}} === Hyundai construction equipment === Mikano serves as an official distributor for [[Hyundai Engineering & Construction]] equipment including: * forklifts distributing and servicing * hydraulic excavators * wheel and skid steer loaders * backhoe loaders and forklifts{{cite web|url=https://www.hyundai-ce.com/english/GNE/ICEGNE.aspx?area=AF&cetype=enb&country=NG |title=HCE | Hyundai Construction Equipment |publisher=Hyundai-ce.com |access-date=2019-05-28}}{{cite web|url=https://constructionreviewonline.com/2019/03/top-construction-equipment-companies-in-nigeria/|title=Top construction equipment companies in Nigeria|first=Anita|last=Anyango|date=14 March 2019}} === Real estate and construction === [[File:Karameh City.jpg|thumb|Mikano International Limited, Karameh City]] In 2018, Mikano International Limited expanded Nigeria's real estate space with the Karameh City Project. The project is its first industrial complex in Nigeria with eight warehouses measuring 7,200 square meters, located at Warewa, Ogun state. Mikano Construction unit also services development and execution of housing projects and [[High-rise building|high-rise buildings]] to turnkey developments and total infrastructural works.{{cite web|url=https://www.mikano-intl.com/construction|title=Mikano International Limited|website=www.mikano-intl.com}} == Corporate social responsibility == Mikano has implemented various social responsibility initiatives focusing on STEM projects and training for Nigerian students,{{Cite news|url=https://www.pulse.ng/news/metro/mikano-awaken-your-creativity-with-the-stem-competition/edb6m4n|title=Awaken your creativity with the STEM competition|date=2 October 2018|newspaper=[[Pulse Nigeria]]}} and partnered with the [[Nigeria Police Force|Nigerian Police Force]] through the donation of police traffic stands across the country,{{Cite news|url=https://www.independent.ng/trace-commends-mikano-over-traffic-stands-in-ogun/|location=Lagos, Nigeria|title=TRACE Commends Mikano Over Traffic Stands In Ogun|first=Our|last=Correspondents|date=6 April 2018|newspaper=[[Independent (Nigeria)|Independent]]}} as well as support for the blind.{{Cite news|last=Adebumiti |first=Adelowo |url=https://guardian.ng/appointments/mikano-clocks-25-donates-items-to-blind-school/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|title=Mikano clocks 25, donates items to blind school | The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World NewsAppointments — The Guardian Nigeria News – Nigeria and World News |date=2019-05-24 |access-date=2019-05-28|newspaper=[[The Guardian (Nigeria)|The Guardian]]}} ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Construction and civil engineering companies of Nigeria]] [[Category:Energy companies of Nigeria]] [[Category:Construction and civil engineering companies established in 1993]] [[Category:Nigerian companies established in 1993]] [[Category:Energy companies established in 1993]] [[Category:Companies based in Lagos]]
extract:
Mikano International Limited is a Nigerian company in the power generation, real estate and construction sectors. This company offers sales, maintenance, assembly and distribution of power generation products, real estate development, and sales of construction equipment.
Headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, Mikano assembles power generating sets from manufacturers; MTU Onsite Energy (Germany), Perkins and Stamford alternator (United Kingdom), providing diesel and gas generating sets ranging from 9kva to 20,000kva for homes and industries.
